The '''1991–92 [[La Liga]]''' season was the 61st since its establishment. It began on 31 August 1991, and concluded on 7 June 1992.  After the penultimate game, [[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]] led by 1 point and needed to win away to [[CD Tenerife|Tenerife]], managed by their former player [[Jorge Valdano]], to seal the title. Despite taking a 2–0 lead, Madrid lost 3–2.<ref>{{cite web |author=<!-- not stated --> |date=21 May 2017 |title=Ghosts of Seasons Past Haunt Real Madrid As Barcelona Hope Miracle |url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/la-liga/articles/ghosts-of-seasons-past-haunt-real-madrid-as-b |website=[[beIN Sports]] |location= |publisher= |access-date=1 May 2025}}</ref> The result meant that [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] – which also won the [[1991–92 European Cup|European Cup]] for the first time in club history – finished the season as champions for the second season running.<ref>{{cite web|last=Giorgetti|first=Javier|date=9 April 2020|title=Barça 1991/92 season: European catalyst from Cruyff's Dream Team|url=https://barcauniversal.com/barca-1991-92-season-european-catalyst-from-cruyffs-dream-team/|access-date=8 April 2021|website=Barca Universal}}</ref>
